fieldDescriptions.EventType: Type of service-provider event. All records are cloud audit events.
fieldDescriptions.OperationName: Specific control-plane or administrative operation performed in the service.
fieldDescriptions.OperationCategory: High-level action category such as Read, Create, Update, Delete, or Export.
fieldDescriptions.FailureReason: Reason a failed operation was rejected when present.
fieldDescriptions.ActorUsername: User or service principal that initiated the operation.
fieldDescriptions.ActorType: Whether the actor is a user or service principal.
fieldDescriptions.ActorIpAddr: Source IP address used for the operation.
fieldDescriptions.ActorCountry: Country classification associated with the source IP address.
fieldDescriptions.ActorUserAgent: Client identifier reported by the service.
fieldDescriptions.AuthMethod: Authentication method used for the operation.
fieldDescriptions.IsPrivileged: Whether the actor had elevated permissions for the operation.
fieldDescriptions.TargetResourceType: Type of resource affected by the operation.
fieldDescriptions.TargetResourceName: Display name of the affected resource.
fieldDescriptions.TargetResourceId: Stable identifier for the affected resource.
fieldDescriptions.TargetUserName: User or service account affected by a role or credential operation when present.
fieldDescriptions.TargetUserId: Stable identifier for the affected user or service account when present.
fieldDescriptions.TargetRole: Role assigned or removed when the event changes access.
fieldDescriptions.WorkspaceName: Logical workspace affected by the operation when present.
fieldDescriptions.DestinationUrl: Export destination URL when the operation creates or completes a data export.
fieldDescriptions.PreviousValue: Prior policy, setting, or resource value when available.
fieldDescriptions.NewValue: Updated policy, setting, or resource value when available.
fieldDescriptions.CorrelationId: Identifier that groups related operations in one activity sequence.

sourceBinding.rationale: The fictional ISV sample does not identify a deployed Sentinel connector or destination table. These draft identifiers are derived from the Fabrikam Cloud Control audit sample and must be confirmed or replaced before solution integration.

context.productDescription: Synthetic cloud audit telemetry from Fabrikam Cloud Control, a fictional ISV cloud governance and workspace-management service provider.
knownSecurityScenarios: Repeated failed privileged role-assignment attempts followed by a successful OrganizationOwner assignment from one unknown external source.
Audit streaming disabled and audit retention reduced from 365 days to 7 days.
Multiple API keys created from an unknown external source.
Service principal credential creation followed by a WorkspaceContributor assignment.
External workspace sharing and public API access enabled for the Finance workspace.
A full Finance workspace export completed to an external download location.
Backup deletion after other privileged changes.
Administrative remediation that restores audit settings and revokes unauthorized API keys.
